family: MOD3, defined in proof.md Section 1: for every integer n>=0 (no exceptions, including f_0(empty)=1), f_n(x)=1 iff the number of ones in x in {0,1}^n is congruent to 0 mod 3. Language L={x in {0,1}*: |x|_1 = 0 mod 3}, decided by a fixed linear-time counter; NP verifier V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and x in L, witness bound W(n)=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=(7/3)n-4 for every integer n>=2 in the full Li–Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|; hence liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=7/3.
